display.title: From Purim to Pesach: One Geulah to the Next
display.summary_short: Between Purim and Pesach, Uncle Yossi links the two redemptions and explains why the final Geulah can come in Nissan, as fast as the blink of an eye.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, broadcast between Purim and Pesach. Our Sages teach that it is good to connect one redemption with another, and Uncle Yossi links the Geulah of Purim with the Geulah of Pesach. In both, Hashem saved the Jewish people with great miracles: at the splitting of the Yam Suf the nations trembled, as we say every day in Az Yashir, and in the days of Purim many people joined the Jews out of awe. So too Hashem will free us from this final galus with miracles even greater than the Exodus, as the Navi foretells. In Nissan we were redeemed and in Nissan we will be redeemed again, and as the Rebbe teaches, this complete redemption will never be followed by another galus. With Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan coming, the month of redemption, children are reminded that Hashem's salvation can come in the blink of an eye, and are asked to be in shul and pray to be in Yerushalayim by Pesach.
display.lesson: Hashem's redemption can come in the blink of an eye; pray for it and get ready for it.

date.note: Cut from episode 370, dated 28 March 1989 in its filename; mentions Purim just past and Shabbos Mevarchim Nissan this week.
